The '''Shuldene system''' was located on the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]] of the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shuldene/Legends|Shuldene]].
